hits.snippet: AGent Energy Raises $11 Million to Unlock Over 200 GW of Distributed Power ... AGent Energy raised $11 million in Series Seed financing co-led by Spero Ventures and MassMutual Ventures, with Intrepid Investment Management, CIV and Zero Infinity Partners participating. The Houston company has secured $17 million during its first 12 months, including a $6 million round completed within two months of founding. Its AI platform aggregates, dispatches and monetises backup generators at commercial, industrial, municipal, university, school, hospital and data-centre sites. AGent targets more than 200 GW of behind-the-meter generation and already operates across PJM, MISO and ERCOT, including during grid emergencies. Funding will expand its team and deployment. Spero’s Stephen Wemple joins the board, while MassMutual Ventures’ Aram Ouligian becomes a board observer. Asset owners receive revenue without paying upfront capital costs.
